style: muted indigo and ochre palette, restrained saturation, archival paper grain, soft directional light, and a quiet museum-editorial composition
projection_guidance: ultra-wide panoramic view, as if scanning the full sweep of the scene
the horizon sits on the vertical centre line and stays level across the full width
distribute subject matter across the full horizontal sweep rather than centring one focal point
no fisheye distortion, no vignetting, no circular framing
constraints: historically grounded objects, architecture, landscapes, maps, textiles, or ships
avoid identifiable historical figures unless the supplied source explicitly requires them
